import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] A = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static int n, t;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][] dp = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];
    static List<List<Integer>> G = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] F = new int[210][210];
    static int[] E = new int[210], H = new int[210];
    static int[][] C = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] pN = new int[11][11];

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            first = f; second = s;
        }
    }

    // replace the recursive setdp method
    static void setdp(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
        if (t >= 70 || x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) return;
        if (A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') return;
        if (tt > t +1) return;
        if (_dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0]) return;
        if (tim[x][y] != 0 && tim[x][y] != -1 && tt > tim[x][y]) return;
        if (tt == tim[x][y] && tim[x][y] != -1 && (B[x][y] > '9' || B[x][y] <= '0')) return;

        _dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0] = true;

        if (tt < tim[x][y]) {
            setdp(tt+1, x, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt+1, x+1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt+1, x-1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt+1, x, y+1, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt+1, x, y-1, x0, y0);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], '0');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], '0');
        }

        for (int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<12; j++) {
                A[i][j]=' ';
                B[i][j]=' ';
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<12; j++) {
                A[i][j]='\0';
                B[i][j]='\0';
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], ' ');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], ' ');
        }

        // Read grid A
        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                A[i][j]=line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        // Read grid B
        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                B[i][j]=line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                tim[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j]=='Z') {
                    tim[i][j]=0;
                    q.add(new Pair(i,j));
                }
            }
        }

        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while(!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = q.poll();
            if (tim[p.first][p.second] >= t) continue;
            for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
                int ni = p.first + di[d];
                int nj = p.second + dj[d];
                if (ni>=0 && ni<n && nj>=0 && nj<n && A[ni][nj]>='0' && A[ni][nj]<='9' && tim[ni][nj]==-1) {
                    tim[ni][nj]=tim[p.first][p.second]+1;
                    q.add(new Pair(ni, nj));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                if (tim[i][j]==-1) tim[i][j]= t;
            }
        }

        // Initialize pN
        for (int i=0; i<11; i++) Arrays.fill(pN[i], 0);

        // Set up _dp
        for (int i=0; i< n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j< n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j]>='0' && A[i][j]<='9') {
                    setdp(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize G with empty list
        G.clear();
        G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        // Initialize dp array
        for (int i1=0; i1< n; i1++) {
            for (int j1=0; j1< n; j1++) {
                for (int i2=0; i2< n; i2++) {
                    for (int j2=0; j2< n; j2++) {
                        for (int nt=0; nt<= t; nt++) {
                            dp[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= _dp[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph based on dp
        for (int i1=0; i1< n; i1++) {
            for (int j1=0; j1< n; j1++) {
                if (A[i1][j1]> '0' && A[i1][j1]<='9') {
                    int k=G.size();
                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    E[k]=A[i1][j1]-'0';

                    for (int i2=0; i2< n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2=0; j2< n; j2++) {
                            if (B[i2][j2]> '0' && B[i2][j2]<='9') {
                                if (dp[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2]==0) {
                                        _k=G.size();
                                        G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                        pN[i2][j2]=_k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k=pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    G.get(k).add(_k);
                                    G.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k]=10000;
                                    C[_k][k]=0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Connect remaining nodes
        for (int i2=0; i2< n; i2++) {
            for (int j2=0; j2< n; j2++) {
                if (B[i2][j2]> '0' && B[i2][j2]<='9' && pN[i2][j2]>0) {
                    int _k=pN[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0]=B[i2][j2]-'0';
                    C[0][_k]=0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Implement Max-Flow (Dinic's Algorithm)
        while (true) {
            boolean ff=true;
            int[] H = new int[G.size()];
            Arrays.fill(H,0);
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[G.size()];
            // BFS to build level graph
            boolean[] levelVisited = new boolean[G.size()];
            Arrays.fill(levelVisited,false);
            Queue<Integer> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            q2.add(0);
            levelVisited[0]=true;
            while(!q2.isEmpty()){
                int u = q2.poll();
                for (int v : G.get(u)){
                    if (!levelVisited[v] && C[u][v]-F[u][v]>0){
                        levelVisited[v]=true;
                        H[v]=H[u]+1;
                        q2.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            // DFS to send flow
            int flow;
            do {
                flow = dfsFlow(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, H, F, C, G);
                if (flow>0) {
                    ff=false;
                }
            } while(flow>0);

            if (ff) break;
        }

        System.out.println(E[0]);
    }

    static int dfsFlow(int u, int flow, int[] H, int[][] F, int[][] C, List<List<Integer>> G) {
        if (u==0) return flow;
        for (int v : G.get(u)) {
            if (C[u][v]-F[u][v]>0 && H[v]==H[u]+1) {
                int pushed = dfsFlow(v, Math.min(flow, C[u][v]-F[u][v]), H, F, C, G);
                if (pushed>0) {
                    F[u][v]+=pushed;
                    F[v][u]-=pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

}
